title: Supercomputer Fugaku - Supercomputer Fugaku, A64FX 48C 2.2GHz, Tofu interconnect D
version: Live system history, June 2020, November 2020 and November 2026 entries inspected

passages.note: The first listing shows 415.53 PFlop/s Linpack Rmax and the second shows 442.01 PFlop/s with more cores. The 11/2020 row reports Rpeak 537.21 PFlop/s, distinct from Rmax. The 11/2026 row carries the same 442.01 PFlop/s result at rank 9. The system uses A64FX and Tofu Interconnect D.
